title: Fails as Decorative Piece; Made of Heavy Fake Marble
text:
Fails as Decorative Piece; Made of Heavy Fake Marble. This INTERDESIGN DAKOTA RESIN MARBLE CENTER (for Toothbrush, Cell Phone; White) is very heavy--it’s almost heavy enough to be marble, but I think it is actually some kind of “cultured stone”. The item has marbling, but doesn’t really look like natural marble.

To my mind, this item fails as a decorative piece. It’s small and blocky, and the metal crosspieces make it look odd. There isn’t any real design to it. Usually InterDesign products are much more attractive than this.

The most interesting feature may be the water drainage hole in the bottom of the toothbrush section. The hole is securely closed with a flexible plastic stopper.

product_metadata.title: iDesign Dakota Resin Marble Pump with Ring Tray, Liquid Soap Dispenser Holds 10 Oz. for Bathroom, Kitchen Sink, Vanity

DURABLE: Rust-resistant resin construction for years of durable use
RING TRAY: Tray allows you to store rings and other small items on top of the holder
STYLISH: White marble print adds an elegant touch to any decor style
IDEAL SIZE: Soap holder measures 5.61" x 2.25" x 6.31"
description: Organize your countertops with the iDesign Dakota Soap Pump! This pump holds up to 10 ounces of liquid soap for your convenience. With a stylish white marble print, you can easily match the pump to your bathroom decor. The resin construction is rust-resistant and durable for years of quality use. The upper tray is ideal for storing rings and other small items to keep them within reach. Soap holder measures 5. 61" x 2. 25" x 6. 31". With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #livesimply every day.
